tier_rationale: Manufacturer's own instructions describe exactly two operating steps — plug into a standard outlet and turn a rotary switch to pick a speed — with no electronics beyond the motor and switch. Lasko Products LLC (FCC grantee 2ATSJ) holds grants for a Bluetooth-equipped 'BLE FAN' and an outdoor fan with a radio, so the vendor demonstrably files when a fan has wireless hardware, and no grant of any kind exists for the B20200.
the_unplug_test: Nothing changes. This fan has no network connection to lose: it is a motor, three blades, a metal cage, and a rotary switch with three positions. You plug it in and turn the dial; there is no app, no pairing step, and no cloud service that could go down.

repairability.notes: Front grill and blades are removable without tools for cleaning per the manufacturer's own instructions. Replacement blades and motors are sold by third-party parts vendors (e.g. Parts Town, Encompass) under the model number.

sources.supports: Manufacturer product page: 3-speed box fan with top-mounted rotary control, weather-resistant motor rated for window use, 1,710 CFM airflow. No app, wifi, Bluetooth, or remote feature listed anywhere in the description or specification table.

Reproduces the manufacturer's own instruction sheet verbatim: 'Plug the Fan into any standard 120V AC household outlet' and 'Using the rotary switch, set the desired Fan speed' are the entire operating instructions — confirms mechanical rotary switch is the sole control.

Sibling control: Lasko Products LLC, grantee code 2ATSJ, holds FCC grants for 2ATSJ-YF200 ('YF200 Outdoor Fan') and 2ATSJT42905 ('BLE FAN', a Bluetooth Low Energy model). No grant exists for B20200 or B20201, confirming the vendor files for its radio-equipped fans and the absence here is meaningful, not an unfiled gap.

notes: Lasko sells a visually similar 'B20201' box fan described as having 'Save Smart Technology' — worth checking before buying on looks alone, since Lasko's naming does not obviously separate the plain B20200 from variants; this record covers B20200 only.
